text:
Leah CSM: Quick fyi — Oryx Labs hit 429s during their sandbox run. They need a short QPS bump + header/IP allowlist for the engineer cohort while they finish onboarding tests.
Omar NetOps: Understood. Please post CIDRs, regions, start/end, and whether auto-revoke is OK.
Leah CSM: CIDRs: 203.0.113.120/30 (eng bastion), 2001:db8:55::/64 (CI). Regions: us-west2 for primary, southamerica-east1 for a regional observer. Window: 2 hours starting 13:00 PT. Auto-revoke yes. Tag logs with renewal_flag:at-risk and cs_owner:Leah.
Ben AM: This onboarding demo ties into a renewal decision in 3w. If this fails they escalate. Appreciate the quick assist.
Omar NetOps: I'll add temporary rate-window on key oryx-sbox-1300 and inject both CIDRs into ingress header allowlist. ETA ~12m. @Infra Bot open a CS ticket for peering + qps bump.
Infra Bot: ticket CS-9881 created  temporary qps bump + ingress header allowlist; link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9881
Tasha Support: I'll spin up a dashboard for 429/5xx and add annotations for the bump window. What key name? Alerts: 429 > 2% or p95 > 1s.
Leah CSM: Key: oryx-sandbox-13.1. Rotate after the window. Capture failing request ids and redact PII.
Yuki Eng: Routing suggestion: steer low-priority batch jobs to the micro model during the bump. Example rule to apply at the edge: 
```
route:
  match: header.x-customer == "oryx"
  policy:
    - name: onboard-bump
      override_rate_limit: 7rps
      regions: [us-west2, southamerica-east1]
    - name: batch-fallback
      model: micro-bison
      when: path startswith "/batch"
```
Yuki Eng: That keeps interactive flows responsive and reduces token pressure.
Omar NetOps: Applied CIDR + header entries and created rate-window. Auto-revoke scheduled at 15:00 PT. Tagged logs customer:oryx and session:onboard-2026-04-12. Peering request submitted; will update with IP.
Tasha Support: Dashboards live. Annotated CS-9881. Pager set: 429 > 2% sustained for 5m or 5xx > 0.4%.
Infra Bot: CS-9881 updated with peering IP 34.140.9.77 and revert job scheduled at 15:00 PT.
Ben AM: I'll run the enablement at 13:10 PT and capture quick NPS + verbatim feedback if any errors occur.
Leah CSM: Checklist: [x] CIDRs/header added, [x] rate-window scheduled, [x] dashboards + alerts, [x] ticket CS-9881, [ ] post-session NPS + error samples.
Tasha Support: Please email top 5 failing request ids + payload snippets (pseudonymized) to cs-evidence@redwood.com and I'll attach to CS-9881.
Leah CSM: Will do. Also please ensure the bumped key is limited to the session and rotated immediately after.
Omar NetOps: Noted and enforced. All changes applied. We'll monitor and revert automatically at the end of the window.
Ben AM: Thanks team — landing this well will help move the renewal from at-risk to engaged. Leah, will post results and NPS after the session.
Leah CSM: Closing loop after the workshop. Will include any prompt-level patterns for engineering to review. :white_check_mark:
